'''Stenn Glidrick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who commanded the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Lieutenant Durasha, sit down! Your father sent word through me, because he knew what your reaction would be. It's about your brother &mdash;''"<br />"''What?''"<br />"''He's been killed. I'm sorry.''"<br />"''Captain, I have three brothers. Which one &mdash;''"<br />"''It's Raine. Your father said there are more details on this holo that accompanied the message I received. Take all the time you need, Celia. I'm truly sorry.|Stenn Glidrick and Celia Durasha|<ref name="CP" />}}
Stenn Glidrick was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CP" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. After leaving the service, he became the commanding officer of [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].<ref name="RM" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Glidrick had to deliver the news to his [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Celia Durasha]], that her brother, [[Raine Durasha|Raine]], had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|battle]] with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].<ref name="CP" />

Glidrick was in command of the ''Kuari Princess'' during the voyage in which the vessel was [[Attack on the Kuari Princess|hijacked]] by the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]].<ref name="RM" /> He was killed in the assault.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|345|Glidrick, Stenn}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Stenn Glidrick was middle-aged, with [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair which was graying. He wore the ''Kuari Princess'' uniform, which was a white tunic and blue trousers with a gold stripe down either leg. Glidrick wore medals on his tunic, a reminder of his service within the Imperial Navy.<ref name="CP" />
